BasePayRouterV2.description: Routes ERC-20 payments with an on-chain fee split. Supports EIP-2612 permit (gasless approve) via sendWithPermit.

BatchPayV2.description: Sends ERC-20 to up to 200 recipients in a single transaction. Supports EIP-2612 permit via batchSendWithPermit.

EscrowV2.description: Time-locked escrow for ERC-20 tokens. Payer releases or reclaims after TTL. Supports EIP-2612 permit via createWithPermit.

SubscriptionManagerV2.description: On-chain recurring ERC-20 payments at fixed intervals. Anyone can call charge() once per interval. Supports EIP-2612 permit via subscribeWithPermit.

relayer.description: EIP-3009 gasless relayer — submits transferWithAuthorization on behalf of users
